name: Rejoice
description: Year-round premium blackberry breeding platform launched by Plant Sciences Genetics (PSG), covered independently by Fruitnet and The Packer as PSG's first year-round primocane blackberry platform, unveiled at the Aneberries International Congress in Guadalajara.

attributes.package_note: The Packer names the specific selection underlying the platform ("the new BK 6-13 variety"); Fruitnet's own coverage describes the platform launch itself without naming a cultivar. Modeled as a brand/platform per the existing BluGenix precedent, with BK 6-13 as its one evidenced component variety -- no other launch varieties were found in the available Evidence, so the list is not padded to resemble BluGenix's five.
